extracted.rawText:
Marcus Chen
marcus.chen@example.com | Austin, TX
Marcus Chen has held the following roles, most recent first: Staff Backend
Engineer at Vertex Data Labs (2022-2026), where he led the redesign of a
distributed job-scheduling system handling several billion tasks per month
across a fleet of Go and Node.js services, working closely with infrastructure
teams to move core storage from a single PostgreSQL primary to a partitioned,
multi-region setup, and where he also introduced Terraform-managed
infrastructure that replaced years of manual AWS console changes. Before that,
he was a Senior Software Engineer at Fieldstone Logistics (2019-2022), building
REST APIs and internal tooling in TypeScript and Node.js for a
warehouse-routing product, and prior to that a Software Engineer at a small
startup called Cartwheel (2017-2019) doing full-stack work primarily in Node.js
and React. He holds a B.S. in Computer Engineering from UT Austin (2017). His
skillset spans Node.js, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, AWS, Terraform, distributed
systems design, and REST API design, with additional exposure to Kubernetes
from his time standardizing deployment at Vertex.
